finding: Enlarged every Arabic block and re-transcribed the vocalization exactly as printed: Q19 sign reads مَمْنُوعٌ الْوُقُوفُ (the draft had مَمْنُوعُ الْوُقُوفِ); Q20-Q22 and the Q23-24 dialogue restored omitted fathas/sukuns/kasras (e.g. أُرِيدُ, الدُّولَارَ, إِلَى, الْجَوَازَاتِ, speaker label سَمِيرٌ); Q22 ends سِيُول with no final vowel mark. Rejected the reviewer's claimed shadda in Q23 option 5: the source prints كُرَةُ (no shadda), so the draft's كُرَّةُ was corrected. Q25: يُون سُو in the stem is bold, not underlined, so the <u> tag was removed. Q21 picture 1 shows the woman seated (as drafted); Q25 picture has six people and (d) holds a camera (as drafted). No translations, derived values or answer information added.
